verdict.rationale: `npx skills add <repo> --list` lists the available skills without installing, and project installs write plain files to `./<agent>/skills/`, committed with the project, so reviewers can read them afterward. The listing only shows skill names, though, not the instructions or bundled scripts each skill would add (docs-13 confirms skills can bundle scripts, templates and resources). Missing for 10: a pre-install preview of file contents or a manifest of scripts, a dedicated command to inspect installed skill files, and independent hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
